data.one_liner: Customizable signal strength indicator widget with bar and sector visual variants.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to visualize signal strength using either stacked bars or quarter-circle sector segments. Supports custom value ranges, threshold-based coloring, rounded corners, and bevelled bar designs.
use_when: You need to display cellular, Wi-Fi, or custom numeric signal strength in a Flutter app.
You want a choice between standard bar-based or sector-based signal visualizers.
avoid_when: You need a comprehensive device connectivity monitoring library instead of just the visual widget.
strengths: Offers two distinct visual variants (bars and sector).
Supports custom value ranges and threshold-based coloring via levels.
Highly customizable with spacing, radius, bevelled edges, and active/inactive colors.
weaknesses: Only provides the UI widget, so you must supply your own signal strength data source.
data.minimal_example:
SignalStrengthIndicator.bars(
  value: 0.6,
  size: 40,
  barCount: 4,
  spacing: 0.2,
  activeColor: Colors.green,
  inactiveColor: Colors.grey.shade300,
)
